body: Orchestrator review of PR #367 (dotfiles-T128-seat-liveness-a01, head d3bc745c: the round-2 fix 3cc248cb on the update-branch head cb9ea17c, base 59599783 merged with 907522c2), read from the fetched head: scripts/check-regime-boundary.sh gains seat_pane_state (upstream agmsg_spawn_path, agmsg_terminal_ref_terminal, agmsg_terminal_ref_id, agmsg_terminal_load, terminal_pane_state in a child bash with SKILL_DIR; any failure prints unknown) and the worker-seat loop names the stale removal only for a gone pane (the first identity row decides), the despawn line otherwise; home/dot_local/bin/common/executable_herdr-agents gains the same function, seat_record_path, print_stale_seats (linked worktrees under .claude/worktrees/ with an identity, printed after the claim line only when the claim was not skipped), the --stale option parsed in remove mode only, every row's state read before anything changes, the orchestrator-identity check kept before both paths, and the gone path (delivery off and leave, each required to succeed before the record moves to the run directory's stale/<basename>.<UTC>, a failed step keeping the record with a stderr line and exit 1, the audit P2 of cb9ea17; no despawn; the despawn path unchanged); the two test modules gain the three named tests and the round-2 test test_remove_worker_stale_keeps_the_record_when_cleanup_fails; the validation pastes the 31-failure baseline comparison (empty diff against origin/main); 167 changed lines outside tests and .orchestration, 169 added under tests; no Bot thread; no finding.
